array.string: First determine today's America/Los_Angeles date. If it is before 2026-08-21, exit successfully without any action. If it is after 2026-09-10, move /Users/bingliu/Library/LaunchAgents/com.smartlingo.qa21.recovery.plist to /Users/bingliu/Library/LaunchAgents/com.smartlingo.qa21.recovery.completed.plist, then make launchctl bootout gui/501/com.smartlingo.qa21.recovery your final action and exit. During the active window, read docs/qa-21-day-codex-recovery-prompt.md completely and execute it faithfully.
